assumptions: OpenTsiolkovsky 1.0.0 (MIT, external binary -- not vendored; see NOTICE; openTsiolkovsky-v1.0.0-<platform>.tar.gz, pinned per-platform SHA-256 digests live in scripts/fetch_opentsiolkovsky.py)
OT pos_eci_*/vel_eci_* read as LAUNCH_ECI (axes = ECEF at the launch epoch, held inertial) and converted to GCRS by orbitopt.flightlab.frames.to_gcrs at the epoch
created_utc is the mission epoch: this adapter is a pure function of (target, vehicle, attitude program), so repeated calls write byte-identical runs

vehicle: E5-05a redesign (task #285): stage-1 propellant load 590 t (2x the sealed 350 t) and a declared burn_end_s cutoff at 134 s (depletion-independent), so MECO/separation carry a COMPUTED 135.6 t separation mass = 105.6 t RTLS propellant reserve instead of burning to depletion; the recovery chain plans from this computed state and the propellant-reserve gate PASSES (13.2 t at touchdown, docs/adr/flightlab-0008).

vehicle: E5-05d (#288) upper-stage redesign: 128 t wet / 8.5 t dry stage-2 at Isp 380 s with a 14 MN boost leg, a declared cutoff into a coast + re-ignition circularisation burn (E5-05b restart block); all numbers from the OpenTsiolkovsky insertion-band campaign closing F9 -- the computed ascent reaches rp 281.8 km / ra 296.1 km at SECO from the computed reserve-carrying separation state (docs/adr/flightlab-0008)

vehicle: Stage-1 tube widened to 5.2 m for the 2x propellant load; same Cd(Mach) table and same 30 t dry mass as the sealed baseline; lofted MECO (elevation 44 deg at burn end, burn extended to 134 s) carries separation to ~90 km / 2.3 km/s / 120 km downrange - the ~180 t-class separation regime task

vehicle: E5-05c (#287) stage-1 resize for the F10 landing: +48 t RTLS reserve (Monte Carlo sized, docs/adr/flightlab-0008) with thrust and mass flow scaled x1.175 at the unchanged 134 s cutoff (11.70 -> 13.75 MN, 620 -> 752.77 t loaded, 569.2 t burned): liftoff T/W and the MECO acceleration stay at the E5-05d values, so the ascent shape and the F9 insertion band hold (rp 272.6 / ra 285.1 km) while separation carries 183.4 t (153.4 t reserve) at 2129 m/s / 93.4 km, the state the +48 t recovery Monte Carlo was flown from.
vehicle: Landing reserve 15 t (planning margin carried by the booster model); the graded minimum is the flight target's recovery.min_propellant_reserve_kg.
vehicle: Derived-not-copied design: campaign + recovery-budget provenance in docs/adr/flightlab-0008.

target: E5-05a redesign target: the ascent must reach MECO with a computed (not depleted) stage-1 propellant reserve and still insert at the 250 km reference orbit; the RTLS recovery chain plans from that computed separation state.

target: Max-acceleration ceiling relaxed to 45 g (uncrewed cargo; holds the computed 38.9 g restart-burn peak with margin, ADR-0008 F10); max-q kept at the sealed 60 kPa value. The insertion band is the F9 closure band (periapsis floor 230 km, |apoapsis - 250 km| < 60 km, plane 1 deg) -- see constraints, task

target: Recovery plan overrides (entry_q_max_pa 250 kPa, max_fevals 140 on the frozen FL-305 start) are per-plan options carried by the mission file's recovery.plan_options, not target constraints; the entry-g ceiling stays at the default 8 g. See docs/adr/flightlab-0008.
